about.en: Galatasaray Fan Token (GAL) is the official fan token of the Turkish football club Galatasaray, issued by Socios.com on the Chiliz Chain at 0x770da1e5ddb22f3ccc2482493bd9b10a7a8a38ae. Holders use it on the Socios.com app to vote in club polls and access rewards; it gives no ownership of the club. Several exchanges list it as GALFT to avoid a clash with Galxe's former GAL ticker.
